risk.title: Review the risks before installing a third-party plugin
risk.body: Plugins and installation scripts may execute code with your current system user's permissions. They may read, modify, delete, or transmit local files, server configurations, account information, accessible passwords, private keys, and terminal history, or use existing credentials to operate remote servers.
risk.index: Inclusion in the index does not mean a plugin has passed a security review. Passing platform compatibility checks does not mean it is safe.
risk.ai: We strongly recommend reviewing plugin source code, dependencies, and installation scripts with AI before deciding to install. AI review may miss issues and cannot guarantee safety.
risk.privacy: Do not submit real passwords, private keys, server configurations, or terminal history for AI review. Handle plugins involving data and accounts carefully.
risk.consent: I have read and understood these risks, choose to install this plugin, and accept the risks of installing and using it.
